description: Footer still says 2020 instead of current year

description: Analytics dashboard is slow for accounts with 10k+ records

description: Deploy step times out roughly 1 in 5 runs on the staging pipeline

description: SMTP relay silently drops reset emails for some domains

description: User preference is not persisted to local storage

description: No throttling currently exists on unauthenticated endpoints

description: Changing a filter does not invalidate the cached search response

description: Large exports silently cut off instead of paginating or streaming

description: Webhook retry logic re-sends notifications instead of deduping

description: Sidebar overlaps main content below 480px viewport width

description: Should return a 400 validation error instead of an unhandled exception

description: OAuth token refresh is not persisted, integration silently goes dead

description: Missing confirmation modal on the bulk delete action

title: Cannot reassign issue to a different reporter
description: PATCH endpoint for reporter_id is not implemented yet

title: Flaky test: test_pagination_last_page
description: Test occasionally fails due to shared mutable fixture state

title: Rate limiter blocks legitimate burst traffic
description: Threshold too aggressive for known partner integrations

title: Onboarding checklist does not persist completion state
description: Checklist resets to unchecked on every page reload

title: Broken link in password reset email template
description: Reset link points to staging URL in production emails

title: Issue list sort by priority is alphabetical, not severity order
description: critical/high/medium/low should sort by severity, not string order

title: File upload accepts files larger than documented limit
description: Backend does not enforce the 10MB limit advertised in the UI

description: Only single-record mutations are written to the audit log

title: Keyboard navigation skips modal close button
description: Tab order in the issue detail modal is not accessible

title: Concurrent writes to issues.json can lose updates
description: No file locking, two simultaneous writes can clobber each other

title: Health check endpoint does not verify data directory is writable
description: Service reports healthy even when disk is full or read-only
